- **Episode Title:** "BREAKING NEWS! The Egyptian Military Was In Provo On 9/10. | Candace Ep 255"
- **Source Used for Analysis:** Transcript (yt-dlp-manual captions, cleaned with video context)
- **Transcript Completeness Status:** Complete (full episode transcript provided)
- New Nodes Introduced (people):  N-200, N-201, N-14, N-203, N-204
- New Nodes Introduced (investigation targets): N-10195, N-10196, N-10197, N-10198
- Existing Nodes Reused: N-1 (Charlie Kirk, referenced throughout)

This episode centers on three distinct artifact-anchored threads concerning activity around the September 10, 2025 Provo, Utah airport during and after the assassination of Charlie Kirk, plus a parallel thread documenting post-assassination pressure campaigns to remove Tucker Carlson from Turning Point USA's speaker lineup.

Evidentiary material presented includes FlightRadar screenshots of a military-contracted plane performing a low-altitude loop over Provo Airport both before and ~26 minutes after the shooting; the public statement issued by Derek and Shelaine Maxfield on September 11 regarding tail number N888KG; FlightRadar records for Egyptian Air Force plane SU-BTT, including a three-year route history; an email tip (not displayed, only described) claiming the SU-BTT flight carried military subcontractors who disembarked in Provo on a discreet mission; a Josh Hammer Daily Mail op-ed calling for Tucker Carlson to be "neutralized"; a Stop Anti-Semitism X post comparing CNN's platforming of Ana Kasparian and TPUSA's refusal to drop Tucker Carlson to the start of the Holocaust; clips from a Seth Dillon / Dave Smith appearance on Piers Morgan; and a TPUSA internal text-chain screenshot in which Charlie Kirk references losing a $2M/year Jewish donor over the Tucker Carlson question.

Investigatively, the episode advances questions about (a) the purpose and identity of personnel associated with the SU-BTT Egyptian military plane in Provo 9/4–9/10, (b) verification of the N888KG manifest and FBO routing, and (c) authenticity and provenance of the TPUSA text-chain screenshots. Structurally, the episode functions as the host's most aggressive consolidation of the "foreign involvement" thesis, paired with the first explicit invocation of host-tier anti-Israel political theology as a parallel interpretive frame.

lines: - **Artifact verbally referenced but not shown:** C-2021 and C-2022 reference an email received via the "DCIA tips box" from an unnamed foreign individual. The email itself was not displayed on screen, and the host's report of its contents is the sole basis for these claims.

- **Requires human verification:** C-2046 depends entirely on the authenticity of the TPUSA internal text-chain screenshot (A-1296.1). Independent verification of the screenshot's provenance, participants, and timestamp is required before this claim can be elevated.

- **Possible transcription error:** A-1299.1 contains the fragment "After and Haiti's the tail number N1098L" which appears to be a corrupted transcription. The intended reference is unclear from context.

- **Timestamp uncertainty:** Exact publication dates for A-1293.1 (Hammer Daily Mail op-ed), A-1294.1 (Stop Anti-Semitism tweet), A-1295.1/A-1295.2/A-1295.3 (Piers Morgan interview), A-1297.1 (Daily Mail headline), and A-1300.1 (Hammer audio clip) are inferred as approximately 2025-10-29 ("yesterday" relative to the 2025-10-30 upload) but not independently confirmed.

- **Claim failed admission test:** Host allegations not inscribed include: (a) "feds were guarding this just like they were guarding the Dairy Queen"; (b) "airport personnel had been instructed to lie"; (c) "there was one person who said they were supposed to land at Million Air FBO, but then suddenly they shifted to another FBO"; (d) Casey Baugh's UVU Baugh Entrepreneurship Institute and plane co-ownership (no displayed artifact); (e) the Maxfields running "a human sex trafficking charity." These remain in the record as host allegations pending artifact support in future episodes.

- **Transcript ambiguity:** A-1295.1, A-1295.2, and A-1295.3 are described as audio clips played on air but specific source URL/program is not stated. The "Candace micro-series" framing in the segment introducing A-1296.1 ("another episode of our new smash hit HBO series, micro-series") is unclear in provenance.
